values.note: County camping rates: Electric/Water/Sewer $30 a night; Reservable Sites $40. Scott County resident $1 off; senior (62+) $1 off; 7 consecutive nights for the price of 6. The rates page does not name the campground for each type; this campground's own page gives electric, water and sewer.
Reservations for stays May to September on Scott County's own WebTrac; 'When not reserved, sites can be rented on a first-come-first-serve basis.'

booking.source: https://www.scottcountyiowa.gov/conservation/scott-county-park/campgrounds/woodside-campground ('Reservations are accepted for stays from May - September. When not reserved, sites can be rented on a first-come-first-serve basis.'), read 2026-11-02

values.note: Page: 'accommodates large Recreational Vehicles'. Select sites are fully accessible. No count or length posted.

note: Scott County Conservation, Scott County Park near Eldridge (18850 270th St), one of the park's five campgrounds. Open grassy loop, no water adjacent. --Claude
summary: Confirmed e/w/s hookups, showers, reservations May-Sep with FCFS when not reserved, season mid-April to mid-October. Added $30 base, $40 reservable. Amperage (50) and pull-through not on the operator's page, left; no count posted; no dump listed on this page (Bald Eagle's is the map's). Pin within ~110 m of the loop.
flags: Booking: the note said mycountyparks.com, but Scott County's mycountyparks page lists only cabins and shelters; the campground page's 'Reservations' link is the county's own WebTrac (https://iascottctyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/search.html?display=Graphical&module=RN&type=Campsites). WebTrac answered 403 to plain HTTP, so per-site lists, lengths and amperage stayed unread (not retried).
